scope: Extracted direct menu-item image URL fields for 50 named items from the Aburi-EN Singapore official online menu/order site. source_pages.evidence: Page contains JSON-LD Organization.hasMenu sections with individual MenuItem names, descriptions, SGD prices and direct image URLs. Image URL for each selected menu item is taken from that item entry.
Lists the three selected outlet names, addresses and units used to cross-match SFA records.

source_pages.evidence: Terms say site material is exclusive property and may not be copied, distributed, reproduced, displayed or transmitted without prior written permission; URL presence is not a reuse license.

confidence_and_limits.source_authenticity: High: first-party Aburi-EN branded order site declares item name, content and corresponding image URL within individual MenuItem records. No external stock source was used.
confidence_and_limits.image_visual_inspection: Not individually pixel-inspected. Item image URL is attached to a named product entry in official menu JSON-LD; visually inspect before any consumer-facing display to rule out poor/incorrect rendering.
confidence_and_limits.exact_branch_menu_scope: Outlet address matching is exact for all three SFA records. The ordering page exposes one brand-level catalogue, not a separately selected/validated menu per branch. Thus item availability for each of the three exact branches is not proven by this snapshot; keep item-to-branch applicability as provisional pending branch-specific confirmation.
confidence_and_limits.image_rights: Restricted reference only. Operator terms prohibit display/reuse without prior written permission; do not set Approved Image URL or publish/embed/cache/redistribute.
confidence_and_limits.freshness: Observed 2026-10-19. Ordering menu is a live catalogue at observation time; items/prices may change.
confidence_and_limits.availability: No login, checkout, order, payment, paid API, or Mapbox request was used.
